questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code coordinates the polling loop with the writer pool? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
The store becomes very slow, so each `insert_many` takes 30 seconds. With `workers=4`, how does the polling loop behave?
choices: It keeps polling and buffers unlimited batches in the executor's queue
It raises an error once the pool's queue is full
It polls until 8 batches are outstanding, then blocks in `acquire` until a write finishes
It polls at the same rate but drops batches when all 4 workers are busy

questions.prompt: Two consecutive batches contain readings from the same device. Which statement about the order in which they reach the store is correct?
choices: They are always written in poll order because the queue is FIFO
They may be written concurrently by different workers, so their relative order is not guaranteed
The semaphore forces batches to complete one at a time
Readings are sorted by timestamp inside `_write_batch` before insertion

questions.prompt: `close()` is called while 3 batches are still being written and 2 more are queued. What happens?
choices: Queued batches are discarded and running ones are interrupted
close() returns immediately and the writes continue in the background
close() blocks until all 5 batches have been processed by the workers
Only the 3 running batches finish; the 2 queued ones are cancelled
